title: GSTR-1 Due Date Extended for August 2026
html:
CBIC Notification 14/2026

The due date for filing GSTR-1 for the tax period July 2026 has been extended to 13th August 2026 for taxpayers with aggregate turnover above ₹5 crore.

  • QRMP taxpayers: no change, IFF optional as usual.
  • Late fee waived for filings completed before the extended date.

Please plan client filings accordingly.

title: ITR-3 & ITR-4 Offline Utility Updated
html:
The Income Tax Department released version 1.2 of the ITR-3 and ITR-4 offline utilities.

Key changes:

  1. New schedule for virtual digital assets (VDA).
  2. Fixed validation error in Schedule BP for presumptive income.

Re-download before preparing fresh returns.

title: Q2 FY 2026-27 TDS Return Filing Window Open
html: The filing window for Q2 (Jul–Sep) TDS returns is now open on the TRACES portal. Ensure challans are matched before generating Form 26Q / 24Q.

title: Office Closed — Independence Day
body:
The office will remain closed on 15th August 2026 for Independence Day.
All pending filings due on that date should be completed by 14th August.
For urgent matters, contact the partner on call.
